release_notes: Prerelease from https://github.com/mwongj/VOD2MLIB/pull/2 (source PR remains open). Adds [LIBRARY] Rebuild / discover inventory to rescan configured output roots and adopt verified Dispatcharr STRMs copied/restored outside the plugin. It makes no Emby/provider requests, deletes no output files, and preserves existing ownership and generated NFO hashes. Schema 2 migrates schema 1 inventories and stores completion markers per output root/connection context. Routine syncs and cleanup skip completed discovery; new roots, missing inventory and failed scans trigger discovery. Missing roots are not marked complete. Failed forced scans invalidate their marker and retry. Unverified files remain unmanaged; imported files need this action before cleanup can manage them. Retains bounded batches, standard-library Linux/Windows support, supervised cancellation/deadlines and timing telemetry. Live-data rebuild followed by preview: discovery 0.002 seconds; complete preview 19.5 seconds with zero errors/warnings. Validation: 306 local tests passed with four Windows platform skips, including migration, edited-file/hash preservation, external adoption, scan failure retry and changed roots; publisher/package checks passed.
